_about: King's Forest (levels 6-16): the furtive poacher in his hiding place a sub-boss, a fox on the rocky path, and the barrow wight in the Barrow Mound, raising the barrow's dead.

phases.message: The barrow wight hisses: "Join the barrow!"

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.telegraph: The barrow wight exhales a breath of grave-cold!

abilities.name: Barrow Blade
abilities.telegraph: The barrow wight raises its rusted blade!

abilities.name: Draining Touch
abilities.telegraph: The barrow wight reaches for you with a pale hand!

44150.name: barrow skeleton
44150.long_desc: A barrow skeleton stands among the grave goods, rusted sword in hand.
44150.description: The bones of some old chieftain's guard, still in rotted mail, still keeping watch over the barrow.

791441.name: wolf grey forest
791441.long_desc: A grey forest wolf slinks between the trees, watching you.
791441.description: A lean grey wolf with a ragged ear and yellow eyes. The king's foresters never cleared this part of the wood, and the wolves know it.
791441.why: the zone's regulars (tools/audit/densify.py fills its empty rooms with them): it had no ordinary foe of its own

patrols.why: a fox runs the rocky path

bosses.why: the barrow wight in the Barrow Mound

mechanics.shout: The barrow wight shrieks, and skeletons climb out of the grave goods!
